metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in New Athens, OH | Harrison County
metaDescription: New Athens sits in Harrison County, deep in Ohio's Utica core. Learn how this county's strong well results affect a mineral rights sale here.
heroLead: New Athens sits in Harrison County, one of the most consistently productive counties in Ohio's Utica/Point Pleasant core, where sparse population and large farm tracts have made it a focal point for operator leasing since the play's earliest days.
intro: Harrison County has some of the lowest population density in Ohio and some of the highest per-well production numbers in the Utica play, a combination that means a relatively small number of landowning families around New Athens control a lot of valuable acreage. If your family has land here, checking your mineral status carefully is worth the time.

sections.heading: Why Harrison County draws so much operator attention
paragraphs: Large contiguous farm tracts made it easier for operators to assemble the acreage needed for efficient drilling units in Harrison County, and results here have consistently ranked among the strongest in the state. Operators including Gulfport Energy built substantial positions in this county during the initial leasing wave, with much of that legacy acreage now held by Encino Energy.

sections.heading: Checking your unit status near New Athens
paragraphs: Given the county's strong development history, confirm whether your New Athens-area parcel is already inside a producing unit. If you're receiving royalty payments, your division order will specify your exact decimal interest, which is the key number for valuing a producing share accurately.

sections.heading: Cadiz recorder records and next steps
paragraphs: The Harrison County Recorder's office in Cadiz, the county seat, holds lease, unit, and deed records for the New Athens area. Given how much activity has occurred here since the early leasing wave, it's worth checking whether your original lease is still active or has expired and reverted.

faqs.question: Is Harrison County a strong part of the Utica play?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's widely regarded as one of the strongest counties in the play, with large farm tracts and consistently strong well results since drilling began in the early 2010s.

faqs.question: Who has operated wells in this part of Harrison County?
faqs.answer: Gulfport Energy built a substantial early position here, with much of that legacy acreage now consolidated under Encino Energy.

faqs.question: How do I check if my land near New Athens is in a producing unit?
faqs.answer: Check with the Harrison County Recorder's office in Cadiz for unit designations affecting your parcel, and confirm whether you have a division order on file if a well is producing.

faqs.question: Does population density near New Athens affect drilling activity?
faqs.answer: It can help. Harrison County's low population and large farm tracts made it easier for operators to assemble efficient drilling units, which is part of why the county has such strong well results.
